/// A node of an artboard instance, with its transform and access to its
/// parent and children. Get one by name with `Artboard.node`. Reads always
/// show the node as the artboard last posed it, animation included.
///
/// ```as
/// let node = instance.node("Hips");
/// if (node != null) {
///     node.rotation = Math.PI / 4;
///     node.setPosition(Vector.xy(199, 299));
/// }
/// ```
export class NodeData {
    /// The x coordinate of the local position.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// node.x = 100;
    /// ```
    get x(): f64;
    set x(value: f64);

    /// The y coordinate of the local position.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// node.y = 200;
    /// ```
    get y(): f64;
    set y(value: f64);

    /// The local rotation in radians.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// node.rotation = Math.PI / 4;
    /// ```
    get rotation(): f64;
    set rotation(value: f64);

    /// The x component of the local scale.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// node.scaleX = 2;
    /// ```
    get scaleX(): f64;
    set scaleX(value: f64);

    /// The y component of the local scale.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// node.scaleY = 2;
    /// ```
    get scaleY(): f64;
    set scaleY(value: f64);

    /// The local position.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let position = node.position();
    /// ```
    position(): Vector;

    /// Sets the local position.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// node.setPosition(Vector.xy(199, 299));
    /// ```
    setPosition(value: Vector): void;

    /// The local scale.
    scale(): Vector;

    /// Sets the local scale.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// node.setScale(Vector.xy(1.4, 2));
    /// ```
    setScale(value: Vector): void;

    /// The node's world transform.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let world = node.worldTransform();
    /// console.log(world.tx.toString() + ", " + world.ty.toString());
    /// ```
    unsafe worldTransform(): Mat2D;

    /// Overwrites the world transform without touching the local transform,
    /// so it lasts only until the artboard next recomputes it, such as when
    /// the node or a parent moves. Use `decompose` to move the node for good.
    unsafe setWorldTransform(value: Mat2D): void;

    /// Sets the node's position, rotation and scale so that its world
    /// transform becomes `worldTransform`.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// node.decompose(Mat2D.withTranslation(100, 100));
    /// ```
    unsafe decompose(worldTransform: Mat2D): void;

    /// The node's children, empty when it has none.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let children = node.children;
    /// if (children.length > 0) {
    ///     children[0].decompose(Mat2D.withTranslation(100, 100));
    /// }
    /// ```
    get children(): Array<NodeData>;

    /// The node's parent, or null when it has none.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let parent = node.parent;
    /// if (parent != null) {
    ///     parent.decompose(Mat2D.withTranslation(100, 100));
    /// }
    /// ```
    get parent(): NodeData?;

    /// A copy of the node's geometry as a `Path` when the node is a path,
    /// otherwise null.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let shape = instance.node("MyPath");
    /// if (shape != null) {
    ///     let path = shape.asPath();
    ///     if (path != null && path.length > 0) {
    ///         console.log(path[0].type); // moveTo
    ///     }
    /// }
    /// ```
    asPath(): Path?;

    /// Always null: nodes are transforms, never a fill or a stroke. A path
    /// effect gets the stroke or fill it applies to as
    /// `PathEffectNode.paint`.
    asPaint(): Paint?;

    /// Null, the same as `asPaint`. A path effect gets the stroke or fill it
    /// applies to as `PathEffectNode.paint`.
    get paint(): Paint?;

    /// Releases the node now instead of when it is collected. It reads
    /// nothing afterwards.
    release(): void;
}

/// An animation of an artboard instance, played by script. Get one by name
/// with `Artboard.animation`. It poses the instance it came from; advance
/// that artboard by 0 afterwards so the change propagates without counting
/// time twice.
///
/// ```as
/// export class Walker extends Node {
///     @input character: Artboard? = null;
///     instance: Artboard? = null;
///     walk: Animation? = null;
///
///     override init(context: Context): bool {
///         let character = this.character;
///         if (character != null) {
///             let instance = character.instance();
///             this.walk = instance.animation("Walk");
///             this.instance = instance;
///         }
///         return true;
///     }
///
///     override advance(seconds: f64): bool {
///         let instance = this.instance;
///         let walk = this.walk;
///         if (instance != null && walk != null) {
///             walk.advance(seconds * 2);
///             instance.advance(0);
///         }
///         return true;
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export class Animation {
    /// The duration of the animation in seconds.
    get duration(): f64;

    /// Advances the animation by the given time in seconds and applies it to
    /// the artboard. Returns true while the animation has not reached its
    /// end; a looping or ping pong animation always returns true.
    advance(seconds: f64): bool;

    /// Sets the animation time in seconds and applies it to the artboard.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// walk.setTime(0.3);
    /// instance.advance(0);
    /// ```
    setTime(time: f64): void;

    /// Sets the animation time in frames and applies it to the artboard.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// walk.setTimeFrames(3);
    /// instance.advance(0);
    /// ```
    setTimeFrames(frames: f64): void;

    /// Sets the animation time as a fraction of its duration, from 0 to 1,
    /// and applies it to the artboard.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// walk.setTimePercentage(0.5);
    /// instance.advance(0);
    /// ```
    setTimePercentage(percentage: f64): void;

    /// Releases the animation now instead of when it is collected. It does
    /// nothing afterwards.
    release(): void;
}

/// The kind of a custom property on a `Drawable`.
export enum PropertyKind {
    /// A number.
    number,

    /// A boolean.
    boolean,

    /// A string.
    string,

    /// A color.
    color,

    /// An enum, whose value reads as a string.
    enumeration,

    /// A trigger.
    trigger,
}

/// One custom property, as `Drawable.properties` lists them.
export class DrawableProperty {
    /// The property's name.
    name: string;

    /// The property's kind.
    kind: PropertyKind;
}

/// What a custom property is read by. Get one from `Artboard.propertyKey`
/// once, in `init`, and keep it: resolving a name scans the file's name
/// table, reading by key does not.
export type PropertyKey = u32;

/// A drawable that carries custom properties, handed to the visitor of
/// `Artboard.draw`. It is only valid inside that visitor call. Custom
/// properties are added to a drawable in the editor's inspector.
export class Drawable {
    /// Whether the drawable has a custom property of this key, of any kind.
    has(key: PropertyKey): bool;

    /// Whether the drawable has a custom property of this key and kind. Use
    /// it to tell a missing property from one holding the typed reads'
    /// fallback value.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// if (drawable.holds(EMISSIVE, PropertyKind.number)) {
    ///     console.log(drawable.number(EMISSIVE).toString());
    /// }
    /// ```
    holds(key: PropertyKey, kind: PropertyKind): bool;

    /// The custom number property of this key, 0 when there is none. Use
    /// `numberOrNull` to tell the two apart.
    number(key: PropertyKey): f64;

    /// The custom boolean property of this key, false when there is none.
    boolean(key: PropertyKey): bool;

    /// The custom color property of this key, 0 when there is none.
    color(key: PropertyKey): Color;

    /// The custom string property of this key, empty when there is none.
    string(key: PropertyKey): string;

    /// The custom number property of this key, or null when there is none.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let emissive = drawable.numberOrNull(EMISSIVE);
    /// if (emissive != null) {
    ///     console.log(emissive.value.toString());
    /// }
    /// ```
    numberOrNull(key: PropertyKey): Box<f64>?;

    /// The custom boolean property of this key, or null when there is none.
    booleanOrNull(key: PropertyKey): Box<bool>?;

    /// The custom color property of this key, or null when there is none.
    colorOrNull(key: PropertyKey): Box<Color>?;

    /// The custom string property of this key, or null when there is none.
    stringOrNull(key: PropertyKey): string?;

    /// Every custom property on the drawable. For tooling and debugging:
    /// the editor and rive-cli have it, a shipping runtime does not, so do
    /// not call it from a script you ship.
    properties(): DrawableProperty[];

    /// Draws the drawable under the renderer's current state.
    draw(renderer: Renderer): void;
}

/// An artboard instance a script draws, advances and forwards pointer
/// events to, with access to its
/// named nodes, animations and data.
///
/// Declare one as an input and make instances of it. `T` is a class
/// extending `ViewModel` that names the view model the artboard binds, so
/// the editor offers matching view models for an input declared as
/// `Artboard<Character>`, and `data` returns a `Character`.
///
/// ```as
/// export class Scene extends Node {
///     @input character: Artboard? = null;
///     instance: Artboard? = null;
///
///     override init(context: Context): bool {
///         let character = this.character;
///         if (character != null) {
///             this.instance = character.instance(ViewModel.create("Character"));
///         }
///         return true;
///     }
///
///     override advance(seconds: f64): bool {
///         return this.instance?.advance(seconds) ?? true;
///     }
///
///     override draw(renderer: Renderer): void {
///         let instance = this.instance;
///         if (instance != null) {
///             renderer.save();
///             instance.draw(renderer);
///             renderer.restore();
///         }
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export class Artboard<T = ViewModel> {
    /// Creates a new instance of the artboard with independent state, bound
    /// to `viewModel` when one is given.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let instance = character.instance(ViewModel.create("Character"));
    /// ```
    instance(viewModel: T? = null): Artboard<T>;

    /// Advances the artboard by the given time in seconds. Returns true if
    /// the artboard should keep receiving advance calls.
    advance(seconds: f64): bool;

    /// The key custom properties called `name` are read by. When no property
    /// in the file carries that name the key matches nothing, so every read
    /// by it finds no property.
    propertyKey(name: string): PropertyKey;

    /// Draws the artboard with the color modulation set, per drawable, from
    /// its custom property of this key: a number as a gray level clamped to
    /// 0 to 1, a color as is. Drawables without it draw under the renderer's
    /// current state. Levels multiply down through tagged drawables that
    /// hold others: inside a nested artboard tagged 0.5, a shape tagged 0.2
    /// draws at 0.1 and an untagged one at 0.5. Nothing calls back into the
    /// script, so this is the cheapest way to draw a pass like emission.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// // In init: EMISSIVE = artboard.propertyKey("emissive");
    /// // Everything black except drawables tagged emissive.
    /// renderer.save();
    /// renderer.setColorModulation(Color.rgba(0, 0, 0, 255));
    /// artboard.drawModulated(renderer, EMISSIVE);
    /// renderer.restore();
    /// ```
    drawModulated(renderer: Renderer, key: PropertyKey): void;

    /// Draws the artboard using the provided renderer.
    ///
    /// With a `visitor`, each drawable that has custom properties is handed
    /// to it instead of being drawn: the visitor decides whether to call
    /// `drawable.draw(renderer)` and under what renderer state. Whatever it
    /// sets on the renderer ends with that visit. Every other drawable draws
    /// as usual, and clipping still applies. `context` is passed through to
    /// the visitor untouched.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let GLOW: PropertyKey = 0; // In init: GLOW = artboard.propertyKey("glow");
    ///
    /// // Draws only the drawables tagged glow, in their own paint.
    /// function drawGlow(context: usize, drawable: Drawable, renderer: Renderer): void {
    ///     if (drawable.boolean(GLOW)) {
    ///         drawable.draw(renderer);
    ///     }
    /// }
    ///
    /// artboard.draw(renderer, drawGlow);
    /// ```
    ///
    /// Drawing a tagged nested artboard visits the tagged drawables inside
    /// it from within that `drawable.draw` call, so a value carries down in
    /// a variable:
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let level: f64 = 1;
    ///
    /// function drawEmission(context: usize, drawable: Drawable, renderer: Renderer): void {
    ///     let outer = level;
    ///     level = outer * Math.min(drawable.number(EMISSIVE), 1);
    ///     let c = <u32>Math.floor(level * 255);
    ///     renderer.setColorModulation(Color.rgba(c, c, c, 255));
    ///     drawable.draw(renderer);
    ///     level = outer;
    /// }
    /// ```
    draw(
        renderer: Renderer,
        visitor: ((context: usize, drawable: Drawable, renderer: Renderer) => void)? = null,
        context: usize = 0
    ): void;

    /// The view model bound to the artboard, typed as `T`, or null when none
    /// is bound.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let data = instance.data();
    /// if (data != null) {
    ///     let nickname = data.getString("nickname");
    ///     if (nickname != null) {
    ///         console.log(nickname.value);
    ///     }
    /// }
    /// ```
    data(): T?;

    /// The width of the artboard.
    get width(): f64;
    set width(value: f64);

    /// The height of the artboard.
    get height(): f64;
    set height(value: f64);

    /// If true, the artboard's origin is treated as the frame origin.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// instance.frameOrigin = true;
    /// ```
    get frameOrigin(): bool;
    set frameOrigin(value: bool);

    /// Creates an instance of the named animation that plays into this
    /// artboard, or null when there is no animation by that name.
    animation(name: string): Animation?;

    /// Adds the artboard's visible shapes to `path`, transformed by
    /// `transform` when given.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// // Rebuild an outline of the artboard each frame, offset slightly.
    /// outline.reset();
    /// instance.addToPath(outline, Mat2D.withTranslation(8, 8));
    /// renderer.drawPath(outline, outlinePaint);
    /// ```
    unsafe addToPath(path: Path, transform: Mat2D = Mat2D()): void;

    /// The node with the given name, or null when no such node exists.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let root = instance.node("Root");
    /// if (root != null) {
    ///     root.decompose(Mat2D.withTranslation(100, 100));
    /// }
    /// ```
    node(name: string): NodeData?;

    /// The bounding box of the artboard as its minimum point `v0` and
    /// maximum point `v1`.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let bounds = instance.bounds();
    /// console.log((bounds.v1.x - bounds.v0.x).toString());
    /// console.log((bounds.v1.y - bounds.v0.y).toString());
    /// ```
    unsafe bounds(): ArtboardBounds;

    /// Forwards a pointer down event to the artboard. Returns a hit test
    /// result, 0 when nothing was hit. Only returns a non zero value when a
    /// hit testable object inside the artboard is hit.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// override pointerDown(event: PointerEvent): void {
    ///     let instance = this.instance;
    ///     if (instance != null && instance.pointerDown(event) != 0) {
    ///         event.hit();
    ///     }
    /// }
    /// ```
    pointerDown(event: PointerEvent): f64;

    /// Forwards a pointer move event to the artboard. Returns a hit test
    /// result, 0 when nothing was hit.
    pointerMove(event: PointerEvent): f64;

    /// Forwards a pointer up event to the artboard. Returns a hit test
    /// result, 0 when nothing was hit.
    pointerUp(event: PointerEvent): f64;

    /// Forwards a pointer exit event to the artboard. Returns a hit test
    /// result, 0 when nothing was hit.
    pointerExit(event: PointerEvent): f64;

    /// Forwards a mouse wheel or trackpad scroll to the artboard, where a
    /// `ScrollConstraint` view under the position can take it. Returns a hit
    /// test result, 0 when nothing took it.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// override pointerScroll(event: ScrollEvent): void {
    ///     let instance = this.instance;
    ///     if (instance == null) {
    ///         return;
    ///     }
    ///     let local = new ScrollEvent(event.id,
    ///                                 event.position - Vector.xy(this.x, this.y),
    ///                                 event.delta, event.phase,
    ///                                 event.precise, event.timeStamp);
    ///     if (instance.pointerScroll(local) != 0) {
    ///         event.hit();
    ///     }
    /// }
    /// ```
    pointerScroll(event: ScrollEvent): f64;

    /// Forwards a gamepad connection to the artboard: its focused control
    /// first, then every scripted node that did not take it. Returns how
    /// many scripted nodes received it.
    /// ```as
    /// override gamepadConnected(event: GamepadEvent): void {
    ///     this.instance.gamepadConnected(event);
    /// }
    /// ```
    gamepadConnected(event: GamepadEvent): f64;

    /// Forwards a gamepad button or axis change to the artboard, the same
    /// way as `gamepadConnected`.
    gamepadEvent(event: GamepadEvent): f64;

    /// Forwards a gamepad disconnection to the artboard, the same way as
    /// `gamepadConnected`.
    gamepadDisconnected(event: GamepadEvent): f64;

    /// Releases the artboard instance now instead of when it is collected.
    /// Do not use it afterwards.
    release(): void;
}
```
